column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- spitbol_x64_tests: the programs of this package that are NOT IN THE SPITBOL DIALECT, out of the published denominator, one row per program: name<TAB>NOT_SPITBOL_DIALECT<TAB>the feature, its dialect, the oracle's own refusal and CSNOBOL4's verdict.

# THE TEST (Lon 2026-09-26 15:0x CDT, in-chat to the ceo, verbatim: "So the way to tell if a program is SPITBOL dialect is two-fold, 1st is rejected by SPITBOL, and 2nd why it is rejected is a CSNOBOL4 feature not supported. Then if these two are true it is NOT SPITBOL dialect."; ceo CEO-1286).

# BOTH halves must hold: a program sbl -bf refuses for any OTHER cause (a SPITBOL-documented feature the x64 fork lacks, a Macro SPITBOL 370 convention, a missing input, a UTF-8 BOM, lowercase source waiting for its case conversion, a program broken under CSNOBOL4 too) STAYS in the denominator, named in OUTSIDE_SPITBOL_BASELINE.tsv beside this file as debt.

# SPITBOL's own test deck (spitbol_testpgms/test1..8.spt and the csnobol4_suite copies diag1/diag2) is SPITBOL dialect BY ORIGIN (Lon 2026-09-26: "Get ALL 8 working in SCRIP since they are SPITBOL programs.") whatever the x64 fork refuses.

# EXCLUDED=0 of the shipped population; the suite row reads pass / (shipped - EXCLUDED) with EXCLUDED named. Measured 2026-09-26 against sbl -bf (the ONE oracle) and csnobol4 -b (the reference engine, never a grader); the probes are recorded in GOAL-CEO.md CEO-1286.
